sentences.zh: 我们赖以生存的权力金字塔， 它并非带来平等，而是带来 平等的尊重。这才是最

sentences.en: The future of the world will be a network, not a pyramid turned upside down.
sentences.zh: 平等的尊重。这才是最 重要的。世界的未来 将是一个网络，而非金字塔，更不是倒置的 金字塔。

sentences.en: The revolution of which I am speaking is a nonviolent revolution, and it's so revolutionary that it even revolutionizes the very concept of a revolution, because the normal revolution
sentences.zh: 金字塔。 我所说的这场革命是一场 非暴力革命， 它如此具有革命性，甚至 颠覆了革命的概念本身。 因为通常的革命

sentences.en: is one where the power pyramid is turned upside down and those who were on the bottom are now on the top and are doing exactly the same thing that the ones before.
sentences.zh: 因为通常的革命 是权力金字塔倒置， 底层的人爬到顶层，却依然做着和

sentences.en: What we need is a networking of smaller groups, smaller and smaller groups who know one another, who interact with one another, and that is a grateful world.
sentences.zh: 以前一样的事情。我们需要的是由 更小的群体组成的网络，越来越小的 群体彼此认识， 彼此互动。那将是一个充满感恩的

sentences.en: A grateful world is a world of joyful people.
sentences.zh: 彼此互动。那将是一个充满感恩的 世界。一个充满感恩的世界是一个充满 快乐的人的世界。感恩的人是快乐的

sentences.en: Grateful people are joyful people, and joyful people -- the more and more joyful people there are, the more and more we'll have a joyful world.
sentences.zh: 世界。一个充满感恩的世界是一个充满 快乐的人的世界。感恩的人是快乐的 人，快乐的人越多， 我们的世界就越快乐。

sentences.en: We have a network for grateful living, and it has mushroomed.
sentences.zh: 我们的世界就越快乐。 我们拥有一个感恩生活网络，它像雨后春笋般涌现，我们之前

sentences.en: We couldn't understand why it mushroomed.
sentences.zh: 无法理解它为何如此迅速地发展。现在，

sentences.en: We have an opportunity for people to light a candle when they are grateful for something.
sentences.zh: 无法理解它为何如此迅速地发展。现在， 人们有机会在感恩之事时 点燃蜡烛。

sentences.en: And there have been 15 million candles lit in one decade.
sentences.zh: 点燃蜡烛。 十年间，已有1500万支蜡烛被点燃。

sentences.en: People are becoming aware that a grateful world is a happy world, and we all have the opportunity by the simple stop, look, go,
sentences.zh: 十年间，已有1500万支蜡烛被点燃。 人们逐渐意识到，一个 充满感恩的世界才是幸福的世界。我们 每个人都有机会通过简单的“ 停下来，看看，走走”来改变世界，让它变得更

sentences.en: to transform the world, to make it a happy place.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有机会通过简单的“ 停下来，看看，走走”来改变世界，让它变得更 美好。这就是我

sentences.en: And that is what I hope for us, and if this has contributed a little to making you want to do the same, stop, look, go.
sentences.zh: 美好。这就是我 对我们的期望。如果这能让 你也想这样做，那就太好了， 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 你也想这样做，那就太好了， 谢谢你。 [掌声]
